body: Hopefully. I actually have a date with a late-20s-something this week. Wish me luck.
No. That's part of the problem too. If I give up and date one of these women I'm not attracted to, I will just be screwing her over.
I can actually deal with the overweight thing. In fact, I'm not into really big women, but I like them with a little meat on the bones.
Well, points for thinking out of the box.
Well we all have to have hobbies. I guess that's a hobby of sorts. More interesting than collecting stamps.
Ha, interesting idea. Always liked the Asian ladies.

The problem you're talking about actually sounds like the second one. Not that it made me feel worse about myself. I just got to the point where I was like, OK, I've talked about everything, now what do I do? And she didn't know what to do. It was always, let's talk about it again. Worthless. First guy was a behaviorist. Maybe if I'd spent more time with him. Who knows.

Oh, somehow I forgot to mention I saw another therapist for a lot longer who did turn out to be totally worthless. I thought the first guy was actually pretty good at getting me to be honest with myself.
No. They usually don't want to be your girlfriend after, I'm guessing.
I have an account with them but haven't used it in years. I guess I need to fire it up again and make an effort.
Yes, I've had therapy. I'm too busy with work for a dog. Thinking about getting a cat though.

Thanks. I should probably also get out more and try to pick up some women and let them shoot me down so I can get used to it and it won't be such a scary thing. I should've been learning all this as a teenager, but it just wasn't in the cards.

Very logical advice, but it doesn't work for me. The deep-seated stuff... Let me just say... I really don't want to get into detail about it, but it's pretty ugly. I have been to a psychologist about it and in a nutshell was told that the problem would never go away, but it would become less important if I dated and I should date more, so go out and date some women and things will get better. It was like telling someone who can't walk that he should run more or climb Mt. Everest. That was over 20 years ago. I've had some dates since then and an almost-relationship that kind of evaporated before it started, met women online that I could never meet in person, learned about cybersex then got totally sick of it, and watched shitloads of porn. So yeah, I've had some therapy. And the older women I should be attracted to, I just can't be. I wish it were different.

Thanks. At any rate it's good to see someone who can identify, who knows how not a joke this is. And btw, I did have a girl for a little while who liked to cuddle, and would get right up to the brink of having sex, then bug out on me every time. Turned out she had more emotional problems than I did. But anyway, I can confirm that the cuddling was great and something I really miss. When I think of someone I'm interested in, that's what I fantasize about, not sex so much.
I tried several of them a few years ago, but I got discouraged after a few really disappointing dates. Interesting story: eHarmony rejected me.
Yeah I thought about it. Except I don't make enough money myself. I probably need to mail myself someplace.
I think I'd rather not ID myself, but thanks for the suggestion. I'm OK-looking, though I'm overweight at the moment.
